witness.title: The Septuagint Version of the Old Testament: According to the Vatican Text, Translated into English (1851).
witness.date_statement: Translation published 1851; USFM source member retained from eBible.org package
witness.repository_or_publisher: Sir Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton; digital text distributed by eBible.org
witness.editorial_policy: Source chapter divisions, verse labels, USFM footnotes and cross-references, descriptive-title markers, and unnumbered continuation segments are preserved by the reader extraction. Translator additions are visibly bracketed. The parser rejects unhandled inline markers.

coverage.structure_description: The locally retained USFM member has 14 ordered chapter divisions and 245 numbered verse labels; two unnumbered continuation segments are preserved. This inventory does not establish completeness against the print edition.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: Two unnumbered continuation segments and USFM translator-addition markers are retained explicitly.
coverage.numbering_policy: Chapter and verse labels follow the selected source member. The 245 labels are an observed digital inventory, not proof of printed-edition completeness or alignment with Geʽez.

rights.statement: eBible.org identifies Brenton's 1851 English translation as public domain. This provider claim applies to the historical translation, not the source site's presentation or other text layers.
rights.rights_holder: Sir Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton; provider-reported status
rights.territory_or_term_limits: Public-domain status is recorded as stated by eBible.org; no worldwide legal determination is made.

review_dimensions.scope: The source page and archived USFM member identify Brenton English Septuagint Tobit; a printed exemplar has not been inspected.
review_dimensions.notes: Digital source identity is recorded; wording against the printed 1851 edition is not collated.

review_dimensions.scope: Fourteen ordered chapter divisions in the selected local USFM member.
review_dimensions.notes: The digital member structure is checked; this does not prove printed edition completeness.

review_dimensions.scope: 245 numbered verse labels and two unnumbered continuation segments parsed from the checksum-pinned USFM member.
review_dimensions.notes: Parser validates nonempty content and source labels; it does not collate wording with the printed witness.

review_dimensions.scope: No independent review against the Greek Septuagint or Brenton printed 1851 edition.

review_dimensions.notes: This is a provider-reported status, not a worldwide legal ruling and does not cover other witnesses.

additional_notes: A Greek-to-English historical translation preserved as a distinct research witness. Its provisional title candidate is not an EOTC identity assertion. It is not a translation from the archive’s Geʽez text; accuracy, alignment, and full edition coverage remain unknown.
